description: Submit an invoice issued to a PERSON, not a company (B2C), through ANAF's /uploadb2c: the same as upload_invoice in every other way. The XML as xml: { path } (build_invoice's path works) or { content_base64, sha256 } from a script; every IBAN must pass its check digits. Goes to the TEST environment unless test is explicitly false. A money tool: the client asks the user to approve each call, on a line read out of the XML and marked B2C. Returns accepted plus the uploadId upload_status takes, or accepted=false with ANAF's reasons. The same bytes are not filed in production twice, by either upload tool, unless refile is true. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

cif.description: The ISSUER's CIF. Defaults to app.json's company_cif.

extern.description: The buyer is foreign and has no Romanian CUI.

refile.description: File again a document whose exact bytes were already sent to production. Refused without it, so a retry after a lost answer cannot file the invoice twice: check upload_status or list_invoices first.

test.description: TRUE by default. Pass false to file with ANAF for real.

xml.description: The invoice XML (at most 10 MB): { path } or { content_base64, sha256 }. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes as standard base64, as a script that read the file wrote them. Needs sha256.

path.description: a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe); a bare name is taken from the first; or a file this server saved in its outbox, by the path it answered. Read byte for byte.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source file, as sha256sum prints it: required with content_base64, checked with path. A mismatch fails as checksum_mismatch and nothing is sent.

name: upload_invoice_b2c
title: Upload an invoice to a person (B2C)
